Body.Content:
Work IQ enables authorized applications and AI agents to access transcript content from supported Microsoft Teams meetings and calls as conversations unfold. Through Model Context Protocol (MCP), developers can combine live conversation context with business data to build experiences such as contextual recommendations, customer-support assistance, action-item capture, and workflow automation—without waiting for a post-meeting transcript. The capability uses an active Teams transcript feed and requires applicable permissions and consent; it does not automatically start transcription.

GA date: January CY2027

Preview date: December CY2026
